Buy Tickets Now

Grammy-nominated INALA. Three experiences. One ticket.

Arrive early. Stay late. Discover our South African wine bar, art gallery, and live performance – all in one night.

Returning 17th September — Book Now

Buy INALA Tickets JAZZ Nights WINE Tasting

An Immersive Cultural Celebration of Music, Artistry, and Refined Hospitality

Three Experiences. One Ticket.

Witness
INALA

Witness the South African musical phenomenon, INALA — a 55-minute journey of music, dance, and storytelling, at your reserved showtime. A global success story reimagined in its most intimate form.

 

Learn more Book now

iGOLI
Wine bar

Indulge in the UK’s first South African fine wine bar, a fully air-conditioned, temperature-controlled environment. Curated by Michael Fridjhon with Spirits & Bubbles SA, it presents site-specific wines shaped by South Africa’s terroirs.

Learn more

Immersive
Art Gallery

Explore Ella Spira MBE’s South African Collection, a multimedia gallery of works painted in situ across the country. Each canvas captures land, people & cultural landscapes at the heart of INALA.

 

Learn more

Current Events

Upcoming & ongoing events

From 19th Aug to 13th Sept

GLOBAL LANDSCAPES RETROSPECTIVE

Public Gallery · Private Art Sales · House of Sisters Grimm · London’s West End. Her Global Landscapes series has been exhibited at Carnegie Hall New York, Sadler's Wells, Dubai Opera, Marina Bay Sands Singapore and Hampton Court Palace.

Learn more
Book Now
17th – 18th Nov

Sabina Desir: Freedom Road Re-Imagined at House of Sisters Grimm for EFG London Jazz Festival 2026

House of Sisters Grimm is delighted to welcome acclaimed jazz vocalist and creative artist Sabina Desir for two special performances as part of the 2026 EFG London Jazz Festival.

Learn more
Buy Tickets
Every Performance Day

South African wine flight tasting

Discover South Africa through a curated tasting flight of three exceptional wines at iGOLI, London’s first exclusively South African fine wine bar.

Learn more
Buy WINE Tasting
Every Friday

African Jazz Nights at iGOLI Bar

Fresh from the stage of the Grammy-nominated production INALA, the artists gather after the show for a 45-minute late-night set of African jazz, rich harmonies, powerful voices and spontaneous musical interplay in a close, atmospheric setting.

Learn more
Buy JAZZ Nights
Every Friday & Saturday

Sensory Notes

House of sisters grimm announces summer 2026 season with the launch of sensory notes, a new immersive art & wine experience, London, June 2026

Learn more
Buy Tickets
View all events

HealthMary Event

House of Sisters Grimm and Healthmary announce exclusive women’s health and storytelling event in London’s west end.

LMG 40th Anniversary Private Takeover

House of sisters grimm to host private performance of Grammy nominated South African musical inala for families of victims supported by killed women charity.

West End LIVE 2026

We are delighted to announce that INALA has been invited to perform at West End LIVE 2026 in Trafalgar Square on 21 June.

Learn more

An antidote to pretty much everything

The Daily Telegraph

An uplifting and thrilling experience, which sent me home with a spring in my step and stirring songs on auto-repeat in my head.

Dance Tabs

As unique as it is, spellbinding… delivered with an infectious enthusiasm.

Sunday Express

The audience is transfixed, transcended, and transported to a thrilling new place and time.

Colleen Jennings-Roggensack, ASU Gammage / Broadway League

The title, in Zulu, means ‘abundance of goodwill’ and Inala is a show true to its name.

Buy Tickets Now

Grammy Nominated INALA – the VIP experience

A premium showcase of South Africa’s finest wines, exclusive seating and access to the stars of the show.

Returning 25th September — Book Now

 

Buy INALA Tickets

The Signature VIP experience

An intimate evening of art, wine, conversation and world-class performance.

Enjoy hosted access to curated South African wines, a private gallery experience, and premium seating for the live performance.

EVERY TICKET INCLUDES

The 3-in-1 INALA Signature experience

  • iGOLI wine bar
  • Multimedia art gallery
  • Live INALA performance

Come early, stay late. All three experiences are yours for the evening.

Book your VIP seats

Step 1: Choose your date Step 2: Enquire Step 3: Confirm

Signature — our most exclusive evening

Signature 3-in-1 premium
Signature

Private producer tasting · Ella Spira MBE gallery tour · photography

Signature
  • Art & Wine VIP experience
  • Terroir Room · table service · private tasting
  • Front row seats
  • Private wine tasting in the Terrior room
  • Meet the cast & producers
  • Enjoy a Glass of South African CAP CLASSIQUE Spier Rosé Brut, Stellenbosch during the show
  • A private tour of the gallery

ON ARRIVAL

Red carpet welcome & portrait photography
Arrive to a red carpet entrance with professional photography. Your evening begins the moment you step through the door.

Glass of Cap Classique — poured by your host
Welcomed by name. Glass in hand.

BEFORE THE SHOW

Private Wine Tasting Room — with the producer
A rare opportunity: taste exceptional South African wines in the company of the winemaker themselves. Three wines. Stories behind every bottle. Table service throughout.

Guided tour of “South Africa Landscape”
A private, curated walk through the original art exhibition by Ella Spira MBE — one of South Africa’s most celebrated artists.

Introduction to the INALA production team
Meet the directors, choreographers and cast before the curtain rises.

SHOWTIME

Personal escort to premium seats
Taken to the best seats in the house at precisely the right moment.

INALA — live performance
55 minutes. The finest seats in the house.

AFTER THE SHOW

The evening continues
iGoli bar, gallery, and the warmth of a South African night. Stay as long as you wish.

      Book VIP Tickets

      After the show

      VIP & Signature ticket holders

      The evening doesn’t end at the curtain

      After the performance, VIP guests are escorted backstage to meet the INALA performers. Part of the Inner Circle — a private moment before the night continues at the iGoli bar.

      • Meet the performers
        A private introduction to the INALA cast — the dancers, musicians, and creatives. For VIP and Signature guests only.
      • Photography moment
        Signature guests: professional photos with the cast. A keepsake of your evening.
      • Return to the iGoli bar
        The night is yours. Bar and gallery open until midnight.

      Join our Inner Circle — Immersive Moments for the Culturally Curious

      Immersive moments for the culturally curious. Request your invitation to bespoke events including private wine tastings, art gatherings, cultural evenings, and exclusive offers.

      • Private tastings
      • Art gatherings
      • Exclusive offers
